originalEntry.title: 81 years of Indonesian history in a minute
originalEntry.title_zh: 1 分钟看完印尼 81 年历史
originalEntry.author: hanifproduktif
originalEntry.description: A 59-second, light-hearted line-drawing recap of 81 years of Indonesian history, with music and an ElevenLabs voiceover.
originalEntry.description_zh: 59 秒线描动画，轻松有趣地回顾印尼 81 年的历史，配音乐和 ElevenLabs 旁白。
originalEntry.prompt: Create an animation that quickly recaps the 81 years of Indonesian history. The style should be simple, lighthearted and fun, in a line drawing animation format, with suitable music and voiceover added. The video should be less than 1 minute
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段动画，快速回顾印度尼西亚 81 年的历史。风格要简单、轻松、有趣，采用线描动画形式，配上合适的音乐和旁白。视频要短于 1 分钟
originalEntry.note: Author: about Rp 9,000 per video, including Rp 2,000 for ElevenLabs.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称每支视频约 9000 印尼盾，其中 ElevenLabs 约 2000。
